mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals monetary easing, which may stimulate equity markets by reducing borrowing costs and increasing consumer and business spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in 60% of periods following a federal funds rate decline, or if the Rank IC falls below 0.03 in walk-forward analysis.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment rates indicate weakening labor market conditions, which may lead to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in 60% of periods following rising unemployment, or if the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts reflects strong demand in the housing market, which may indicate broader economic strength and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in 60% of periods following housing starts growth, or if the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production suggests supply chain disruptions or reduced economic activity, which may lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in 60% of periods following industrial production declines, or if the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When both unemployment rates rise and employment levels fall, it indicates a weakening labor market, which may lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in 60% of periods with rising unemployment and falling employment, or if the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate during a monetary tightening cycle may lead to increased borrowing costs and reduced consumer and business spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in 60% of periods following federal funds rate increases, or if the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales indicates reduced consumer demand, which may lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in 60% of periods following retail sales declines, or if the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When employment levels rise and unemployment rates fall, it indicates a strong labor market, which may lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in 60% of periods with rising employment and falling unemployment, or if the Rank IC is below 0.03.
